newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Democrats return $1.5 mln in campaign funds.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Democrats return $1.5 mln in campaign funds.

text.p: President Bill Clinton's Democratic party announced on Friday it was returning $1.5 million in 1996 campaign donations that may have been illegal or inappropriate under U.S. campaign finance laws.

The party's new national chairman, Gov. Roy Romer of Colorado, said at a news conference that as a result of an audit of Democratic fundraising, "We will return contributions from 77 donors totaling $1.5 million."
